actions.speaker: player
actions.title: Rise of the Iceni
actions.body: I am Boudica. Rome thinks us weak — tap the wild land beyond our border and seize it.

actions.title: Rise of the Iceni
actions.body: Tap the wild land beyond our border and seize it.

actions.title: Grow the Warband
actions.body: Keep pushing outward — every tile feeds troops and gold into the revolt.

actions.title: First Blood — the Cassi
actions.body: The Cassi knelt to Caesar and still lick Roman boots. Drag your warriors into them and blood your spears.

actions.speaker: Cassi
actions.title: Independent clan
actions.body: We are the Cassi, who knelt to Caesar a hundred years past. We are few, queen of the Iceni — be swift.

actions.title: Bring the Kneelers to Heel
actions.body: Bibroci, Ancalites, Segontiaci — every clan that bowed to Rome. Devour all four.
